greet.text: Outside the lantern-light, a grey-skinned woman sits alone on a stone, facing north. She has no lantern. She doesn't look up.

why.text: "We don't light them," she says at last. "We remember instead." A long pause. "Moss. That's my name. Somebody should say it tonight."

what.text: "What everyone singing over there forgot." She nods towards the fire, the song, the children. "Go and have your cake. It isn't your fault. Not yet."
